title: Grateful Dead Live at Universal Amphitheatre on 1973-06-30
source: Audience Source Tape: Reel dubbed in 1979 by Will Boswell (3 3/4ips) from Jerry Garcia's personal collection. Original recording made by the sound crew at the soundboard; Transfer info: Akai GX636 direct tape head output > Bottlehead tube tape pre w/ a pair of Telefunken tubes circa 1960 > Apogee Mini Me 24/96 > Apogee Mini DAC monitoring and mastering > FLAC

ai_review.summary: Good audience‑sourced transfer that captures the high‑energy, quintessential 1973 Dead vibe.
ai_review.review: The 24‑bit audience transfer from Jerry Garcia’s personal reel is praised for its hall ambience and overall clarity, making it a solid listening source. Fans rave that the show epitomizes the 1973 era and delivers high energy, though some reviewers criticize the archive’s lack of version notes. Overall the performance shines despite mixed opinions about documentation.

ai_rating.rationale: One highly positive review (5★) highlights the show’s energy, while two low‑rating reviews (1★ each) focus on archival version confusion rather than performance; weighting gives a moderate overall score.

recording_quality.technical_notes: 24‑bit audience transfer digitized from a 1979 reel dub of Jerry's personal collection; reviewers note clear hall ambience and decent fidelity, though no specific issues are mentioned for this version.

show_quality.setlist_flow: No detailed setlist discussion in the reviews; overall described as a quintessential 1973 show with strong energy throughout.
